title: Apple Q2: iPhone up 22% YoY to $56.99B, vs. $57.21B est., Mac up 6% to $8.4B, iPad up 8% to $6.91B, and Wearables, Home, and Accessories up 5% to $7.9B (Jennifer Elias/CNBC)
summary: Jennifer Elias / CNBC: Apple Q2: iPhone up 22% YoY to $56.99B, vs. $57.21B est., Mac up 6% to $8.4B, iPad up 8% to $6.91B, and Wearables, Home, and Accessories up 5% to $7.9B — Apple reported earnings and revenue for its fiscal second quarter that topped analysts' estimates, driven by growth in the company's services business.
